note: RV park on 17 acres on Mac Thompson Rd outside Cochran, beside a golf course: open-field rows of pull-throughs. Two ponds, no swimming. --Claude
summary: Private: $40/night posted on the operator's own site (2026), full hookups 30/50 A, open year-round; no gateway (Atlanta 182 km), not a Good Sam Park, Google 4.8/38. Confirmed $40 nightly; added water/sewer and 50 A, showers/laundry/wifi, year-round, booking by request form. Website should move to https (http times out). Long-stay leaning but a nightly rate is posted.
flags: GATE (passes): cheapest night $40 on the operator's own rates page (2026 footer); paying by card adds 4% + a service fee ($41.60+), and cash/check/Venmo are accepted, so under $50 either way. No gateway within 40 km (Atlanta 182 km, Savannah 214 km). Good Sam directory gs false. Google Maps 4.8 from 38 reviews; phone (478) 230-8057.
Website: http://woodlandrv.com/ times out (curl, 25 s); https://woodlandrv.com/ answers 200 with the same site. Suggest website https://woodlandrv.com/.
Second phone posted on every page and the form: 478-308-3927 (Kyle); 478-230-8057 (Chara) matches the stored phone.

Long-stay leaning (passes test 2: nightly $40 posted on its own site): monthly 30/50 A rates, metered electricity for long stays, $25/month storage, and the registration agreement 'my RV or Rig must be in working order or presentable'. Google reviews: '6 months ago ... in just the three days we were there'; '3 years ago: Stayed here ... for the winter this year from December to May'; 'a year ago: We are booked for next winter'. Mixed short and winter stays; no sign of a workforce park. The site states no share of nightly sites.
Pin 32.3619,-83.3421 sits on the RV rows on imagery: fine. The two ponds are 200+ m from the rows, so stored not waterfront stands.
